title: Campaign code stays in view in the desk header and the Requests empty state says how players join
where: Lightkeeper desk, header and Requests tab, 1440x900
steps: 1. Sign up as a new Lightkeeper. 2. Hub > New campaign, name 'The Gullhaven Chapter', code gullhaven-r4. 3. Look at the desk header; open Requests.
expected: The code is easy to find to read out to the table.
actual: Header shows 'Code gullhaven-r4' on every tab; Requests says 'No one waiting to join. New players ask with the campaign code gullhaven-r4.' Sign-up to a running desk took four form fields and two clicks, with no console errors.

title: End Assignment is live on a brand-new campaign with no dispatch and no investigators; its confirm covers the dispatch character counter
where: Lightkeeper desk, Roster tab, dispatch card, 1440x900
steps: 1. Create a new campaign. 2. On the Roster tab, press End Assignment on the dispatch card (nothing has been dispatched, 'Not dispatched yet').
expected: End Assignment disabled (or explained) until an assignment has been dispatched; its confirm popover does not cover other text.
actual: The button is enabled and arms ('Press again to end the assignment.' / What ending does / Keep going / End). The popover sits over the dispatch box's '0 / 2000' counter (only '000' shows). The two-press confirm itself works, and Keep going disarms it.

title: Illumination ring milestones (3, 6, 9) look special but nothing on the Lightkeeper's circle page says what they are, and screen readers do not hear 'milestone'
where: Lightkeeper desk, Circle tab, Circle charter, Illumination ring
steps: 1. Open Circle tab on a new campaign. 2. Look at the 12-pip ring: three pips (3, 6, 9) are larger with gold rings.
expected: A short legend or the About Illumination tip says milestones earn back a resource only with Resource Management; the pip buttons' accessible names include 'milestone' (the title tooltip already does).
actual: Three gold pips with no legend; aria-label is just 'Set Illumination to 3' (IlluminationRing.jsx uses the milestone text only in title, which hover users see and screen readers mostly do not).

title: Field Notes table of contents is a blank page on a new campaign
where: Lightkeeper desk, Notebook tab, Field Notes, 1440x900
steps: 1. New campaign. 2. Open Notebook > Field Notes.
expected: A short empty state, e.g. 'No field entries yet: entries you or the players add appear here.'
actual: 'Table of Contents' heading over an empty ruled area (the list 'Contents' is empty for screen readers too); the Add entry button is below the fold at this laptop height.

actual: my first look 1s after click showed the unchanged step 4 page; the Join a Campaign dialog only showed after about 2-3 more seconds, so a second click is tempting

Markdown in Cass's style stays literal and emoji render.

title: Lightkeeper's Circle page offers Edit name, Chapter house and Circle ability during formation, with no word that the seal overrides them (or that her chapter house overrides the players')
where: Lightkeeper desk > Circle tab > Circle charter, before Finalize the circle, 1440x900
steps: 1. Approve 4 investigators; do not finalize. 2. Open Circle tab. 3. Charter shows 'Unnamed Circle' + Edit, an editable Chapter house box, and a Circle ability dropdown, while the same parts are being voted on in the players' formation papers.
expected: Before the seal, the charter's name, chapter house and ability are read-only (or say 'being decided in circle formation; the seal will set this'), so the Lightkeeper does not unknowingly fight the vote.
actual: All three are live with no hint. Per source (backend/vtt/routers/circles.py finalize, ~l.252-282): a name set here is overwritten at the seal by the voted/suggested name, the ability by the voted ability, but a chapter house typed here wins: the players' chapter house answer is only copied 'if not circle.chapter_house_location', so what the players wrote is silently dropped. Not exercised on the site, to keep the formation clean; read from source.

title: No explicit 'start circle formation' step, and Finalize is one confirm away from sealing with nothing voted; armed text says 'leaving 4 parts empty' without naming which of the six

actual: Armed slip reads 'Press again to seal the circle for good with 4 investigators, leaving 4 parts empty.' with Not yet. A Lightkeeper who is used to 'starting' formation finds no control for it; she has to read 'Approving a request opens these papers on that investigator's desk.' 'Not yet' disarmed fine; no console errors.

actual: 5 of 5 each, Spending locked with Allow spending, and the note 'each refills to 5 (1 plus the circle's 4 members)'. Was 1 each on the empty campaign (turn 1).
